summary: SmarToken's campaign grants a one-time $5 promotional credit for OpenAI-compatible model calls to existing users and eligible new Google users. The campaign ends on December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC+8. New users must be low-risk Google users, pass the stated signup checks, and receive the credit once per account; no credit card is required.
claim_steps: Create or use a SmarToken account before December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 UTC+8.
If you are a new user, sign in with Google and pass SmarToken's low-risk signup checks.
Use the one-time $5 promotional balance for OpenAI-compatible model calls; no credit card is required.

social_proof.title: $5 Free API Credit for Existing Users and New Sign-ups | SmarToken
social_proof.text: Every existing SmarToken user and every new sign-up gets $5 in free credit for OpenAI-compatible model calls; the campaign deadline is December 31, 2026 at 23:59:59 (UTC+8). No credit card is required.
